notes.title: Nominate Super Mega Zero for the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
It's time for the 2022 Steam Awards! It's been an amazing year of gaming and now it's up to you to choose your nominees. Super Mega Zero transports you back to the 80s with its chiptune music, bright colors, and arcade aesthetics for a stand-out visual style. 

For all our players who have loved this game and its retro pixelated look, we'd be honored to be considered for Outstanding Visual Style in the Steam Awards.

[previewyoutube=uSxMxSudbpM;full][/previewyoutube]

Grab a few quarters and an energy drink and enjoy an arcade challenge, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581880/Super_Mega_Zero/]50% off[/url] through November 29!

We appreciate all your support!
